"""Answer a ticket with an agent."""
from langgraph.prebuilt import create_react_agent

from support.tools import lookup_order


def answer(model, ticket: str) -> str:
    agent = create_react_agent(model, tools=[lookup_order])
    result = agent.invoke({"messages": [("user", ticket)]})
    return result["messages"][-1].content
